messages.content: Have you ever had a pet run away?
Yes when I was little.
Mine came back this afternoon! She is sitting beside me as if nothing happened. Help me choose a funny nickname for this little escape artist.
I studied all week last week in preparation for my midterm, but when I got the results back, I was disappointed to see a low mark.
Did you get sleepy while studying?
Not really, but I have had enough exam talk for tonight. I am choosing a movie now—comedy or science fiction?
We just got back from vacation and our sleep times are off. It is really messing with me.
That will mess you up for a few days. The only thing I don't like about going away.
The funny part is that I found the children still watching cartoons this morning. Guess which show they thought was worth staying awake for.
So I applied for 200+ jobs and I can't believe I didn't hear from none of them!
Bummer!!! Are you looking for a work at home job or just an outside job?
Honestly, I need one evening without discussing applications. I found a ridiculous cooking show—want to help me judge the dishes?
I was able to save a blind lady from falling down an escalator.
Is she ok? Im glad you were close by!
She was okay. My brother now keeps calling me “Escalator Batman.” That nickname is ridiculous, right?
My mom went back to school at 63 and recently got her bachelor's in computer science!
Wow That's amazing. You must be very proud of her. I think coding, etc, seems very hard.
We are planning her celebration. Help me choose: a laptop-shaped cake or one covered in terrible programming jokes?
I hadn't worn a bathing suit in maybe 5 years until recently.
Why is that?
I finally bought one with bright yellow pineapples and had a great day at the beach. Be honest—is that pattern fun or ridiculous?
It was amazing sitting on the stage in that huge auditorium.
What event was taking place?
It was an all-state band performance. I played the trumpet and probably annoyed the whole neighborhood while practising. What instrument would you have chosen?
Today is my birthday! I think tonight we are all going out.
Awesome! Happy Birthday to you! Where are you going?
Maybe an amusement park! More importantly, help me settle this: birthday cake or an unreasonable amount of ice cream?
Went out with my friends last night after not seeing each other for a year. I was in another country for work and just got back.
Oh, I bet that was fun and interesting visiting another country too.
It was! We spent half the night arguing about who had changed the most. Want to guess what they teased me about?
